text: この　くらいの　キズ　なめときゃ　なおるわね！

structure.jp: この　くらいの　キズ
structure.en: a cut as small as this

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. なめときゃ is a slurred なめておけば. なめときゃ = 'if I just lick it'.

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく after a verb means to do something and leave it at that; in speech it shrinks to とく. なめとく = 'just lick it and leave it', and here it is in the 'if' form, なめときゃ = 'if I just lick it and leave it'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to state something, and ね adds 'right?'. なおるわね = 'it'll heal, won't it'.
